en.headline: Oxfam Trailwalker begins in Sai Kung with nearly 4800 participants
en.dek: The 41st edition of the 100km fundraising race started at 8am from Pak Tam Chung under cold and wet conditions.
body: The first wave of participants in the Oxfam Trailwalker set off from Pak Tam Chung in Sai Kung at 8am on Friday.

Nearly 4,800 people in close to 1,200 teams, supported by nearly 3,000 volunteers, are taking part in the 41st edition of the event, which coincides with Oxfam Hong Kong’s 50th anniversary, according to reports.

More than 870 teams are completing the signature 100km route along the MacLehose Trail to Harrow International School in Tuen Mun, with staggered starts throughout the morning. A separate 20km course starts from Tai Mo Shan on Saturday.
Special traffic arrangements are in place in parts of the New Territories to facilitate the event, the Transport Department said earlier.

zh.headline: 樂施會毅行者西貢起步 近4800人參加百公里籌款賽
zh.dek: 第41屆樂施會毅行者百公里籌款賽周五早上8時於西貢北潭涌起步，近4800人參與。
body: 樂施會毅行者第一波參加者周五早上8時於西貢北潭涌起步。
據報道，接近1200支隊伍、近4800名參加者在約3000名義工支持下參與今屆賽事，適逢樂施會香港成立50周年。
超過870支隊伍沿麥理浩徑完成標誌性的100公里路線，終點為屯門哈羅國際學校，早上分批起步。周六另有20公里賽事由大帽山出發。
運輸署較早前表示，新界部分地區已實施特別交通安排以配合活動。
